messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: High error rate for tenant NimbusPay (VPC) detected by latency/error detector. Affected route: /v1/generate, observed 5xx spike + token latency > 2s. Alert level: P1. Paging oncall.
Maria G.: Acked. I'm oncall for infra this window. Pulling logs now.
Ajay P.: I'm seeing a lot of Transformer runtime OOM spikes on the dedicated pool assigned to NimbusPay. Errors reference kv-cache misses + model swap failures.
Lin (Eng-ML): Looks like the customer was recently rolled to model nimbus-v2.2-beta (onnx-8bit). We had a compatibility patch flagged in QA. Suspect quantization kernel mismatch on that instance family.
Ezra (SRE): Thanks — can we quickly pin them back to last known-good safe variant (nimbus-v2.1-stable) while we triage? That will reduce error surface and preserve logs.
Maria G.: Agreed. Running tenant override to route NimbusPay to safe variant and disable auto-rollout. Command:

```
# pin tenant model and disable auto-rollout
redwoodctl tenant override set --tenant=nimbuspay --model=nimbus-v2.1-stable --pin=true --disable-autoroll=true --reason="incidence-2460009876: runtime failures on v2.2-beta"
```

Maria G.: Executed. Routing change shows active on 3/3 endpoints. Traffic shifting now to nimbus-v2.1-stable (dedicated pool fallback). Monitoring metrics.
Ajay P.: Error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.1% in the last 90s. Latency back toward baseline. No new OOMs logged. :thumbsup:
Kate (CS): Notifying NimbusPay CSM and providing reconciliation ETA. Will send brief to customer: impact, mitigation (pinned to stable), follow-up plan.
Lin (Eng-ML): We should capture the failing binary/replicas for post-mortem — kernel mismatch likely. Can eng-ml request replica artifacts? Suggest: collect model config, runtime flags, kernel version, and perf traces.
Ezra (SRE): On it. Snapshotting pods and storing traces in /artifacts/incidents/2460009876. Command used:

```
redwoodctl snapshot collect --tenant=nimbuspay --labels="rollout=v2.2-beta" --out=/artifacts/incidents/2460009876
```

Ezra (SRE): Uploaded traces and perf logs. Tagging eng-ml.
Lin (Eng-ML): Got them. Starting diff against v2.1-stable. Early look: attention-cuda kernel fallback to generic path for sequence lengths >1024 which could trigger memory pattern change under our batching heuristics.
Sam (Product): Heads up: NimbusPay is SLA enterprise; need an internal blameless writeup and customer-facing notes. Kate, loop in legal if they ask for root cause timeline.
Kate (CS): Will prepare immediate customer note: short summary, current state (pinned), and next steps (RTC with eng if needed). ETA 30m.
Maria G.: Suggest we also enable a temporary routing rule to route a small % (5%) of traffic to a warm-standby region running v2.1 to test stability before full unpin rollback. Can we do a canary?
Ajay P.: Yes. Creating policy:

```
redwoodctl routing policy create --tenant=nimbuspay --name=nimbuspay-canary --rules="priority=stable,weight=95;region=primary|weight=5;region=secondary-v2.1" --duration=30m
```

Ajay P.: Policy applied. Canary traffic now at ~5% to secondary region (v2.1). Observing for errors.
Maria G.: Good. Monitoring dashboards: errors low. I propose keeping the pin until Eng-ML provides a regression patch or we back out the v2.2 binaries from their pool.
Lin (Eng-ML): I’ll prioritize a hotfix. If we can reproduce kernel mismatch locally, we can push a patched v2.2-compat build that avoids the offending attention kernel selection. Est time: 3-6 hours for fix + QA. If they need faster, we keep pinned.
Sam (Product): Customer communication plan: 1) Short notice now, 2) follow-up with timeline (we'll indicate 4-6h for root cause/fix), 3) post-incident report within 48h. Kate will send now.
Kate (CS): Message sent to NimbusPay CSM thread — letting them know we detected high error rate, pinned to stable variant, and will provide a technical update in 4 hours. They acknowledged, want to know if key data was affected (no evidence of data loss). :white_check_mark:
Maria G.: Quick checklist for handoff to day team: - keep pin active - maintain canary at 5% - keep snapshot artifacts - eng-ml to triage v2.2 compatibility - CS to own customer comms - open postmortem ticket: PM/SRE/Eng-ML assigned
Ezra (SRE): Creating incident ticket: INC-2460009876, adding timeline, artifacts link, and assigning to Lin, Ajay, Maria, Sam, Kate.
Maria G.: I'm handing off monitoring to day-shift SRE @ 08:00 PST. If anything regresses, page oncall immediately and escalate to incident channel.
Lin (Eng-ML): I'll push updates to the ticket as I have them. First replication test in 45m.
Ajay P.: We'll keep the canary running. If canary stays clean for 30m, consider reducing pin duration but still hold auto-rollout disabled until fix verified.
Sam (Product): Thx all. Keeping this thread for coordination. If you need me to join a call, ping.
incident-bot: NOTE: This thread was escalated to P1 and has runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nimbuspay-fallback. Incident owner: Maria G.
Maria G.: Closing immediate loud alerts. Continuing monitoring and coordinating with Eng-ML. Will open a separate postmortem channel once we have root cause.
